ggsegCraddock

Craddock spatially constrained spectral clustering parcellations for the ggsegverse Ecosystem.

Installation 

# From r-universe
install.packages("ggsegCraddock", repos = "https://ggsegverse.r-universe.dev")

# From GitHub
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("ggsegverse/ggsegCraddock")

Available atlases

Atlas Cortical Subcortical
Craddock 200 craddock200_cortical() craddock200_subcortical()
ADHD-200 CC200 adhd200_200_cortical() adhd200_200_subcortical()
ADHD-200 CC400 adhd200_400_cortical() adhd200_400_subcortical()

Craddock 200 

library(ggsegCraddock)
plot(craddock200_cortical())

plot(craddock200_subcortical())

ADHD-200 CC200 

plot(adhd200_200_cortical())

ADHD-200 CC400 

plot(adhd200_400_cortical())

Data source

  • Craddock 200: NITRC
  • ADHD-200 CC200/CC400: NITRC

Reference: Craddock RC, et al. (2012). A whole brain fMRI atlas generated via spatially constrained spectral clustering. Human Brain Mapping, 33(8):1914-1928. doi:10.1002/hbm.21333
